body.title: Attention needs a floor
body.reason: The community is reaching more accounts while enough SOL remains in the quoted pool. I want depth and distribution to hold as attention grows.

body.title: Quiet participation
body.reason: A slower community is attracting repeat participation. The position depends on maintained depth, sufficient activity and a bounded cohort share.

body.title: Verify the source disagreement
body.reason: The community has broadened, but reserve observations must agree before the depth condition can be treated as supported.

body.title: A reason needs current evidence
body.reason: The entry depends on three observations remaining fresh. I will revisit the thesis when the evidence window expires.

body.title: Distribution before expansion
body.reason: The first reason focused on participation. A later revision must explain why the position remains open under a more specific condition set.

body.title: A completed research file
body.reason: This position was tracked through a declared review window and then closed by the owner. Its history stays available.
